name: Maji de Watashi ni Koishinasai! A Plus Disk
original_name: 真剣で私に恋しなさい！Ａ プラスディスク
source:
Three mini-scenarios about Mogami Aki, Bushou and the Hound Squad (mainly Thelma). Contains one new h-scene for Benkei and the Student Council President. When all three routes are cleared a new route appears.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://www.minatosoft.com/majikoi-a-pk]official website[/url] and expanded by EcchiOujisama]
